name: @deterministic-code/migraters
description: Migrate executables for deterministic-code (typescript, rust, csharp).

scripts.test:proof: docker compose -f proof/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait && bash proof/ensure-instant-client.sh && cargo build --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --target-dir rust/target && dotnet build csharp && npm run build --prefix typescript && npm run test:proof --prefix typescript
